# Teina

> Teina (Teína) is an indie pop rock band from Calasparra, Murcia, Spain. They perform reinterpreted covers of Spanish and international indie music alongside original songs. Available for concerts, festivals, weddings and private events across Spain.

## About

Teina is a 6-member band: Juanjo (guitar, vocals), Nacho (sax, percussion, backing vocals), AJ Ruiz (bass), J.A. Garre (keyboards), Adri (drums), and Darwin (guitar, backing vocals). Based in Calasparra in the Northwest of the Region of Murcia, they combine indie pop, pop rock and alternative rock with honest lyrics and energetic live performances.
